propositions: Extract identity transition rules (bind, confirm, unbind, reverse cleanup, numeric-ID re-key) from BindingStore into a cohesive BindingLifecycle slice while preserving exact existing behavior
Each transition must maintain at most one forward entry and one matching reverse entry via targeted single-key pops, with no ambiguity detection or abort
bind_confirm must remain last-writer-wins on forward entry and pop exactly one differing old reverse key with no sweep or abort
Numeric-ID re-key operation re-keys moved issues in-place instead of retiring them, resetting absence count and updating both indexes atomically
Stale reverse entries removed only in permitted cases: rebind to different key, unbind with orphan sweep, re-key with old-key pop, and retire
Public facade retains all signatures and owns coordination; lifecycle methods operate on repository-owned dictionaries with note_absent_or_rekey as seam remaining facade-owned
